title: FaultForge factory configuration, version 1
description: The repositories the factory works on, and how each one is checked, started, guarded and ticketed. Read by the guard hook, the readiness check and the skills. Holds no secrets.

evidence.description: Where saved reviews and live-check transcripts go, relative to this repo. Always inside the git-ignored private/ folder, never a public one.

gate.description: The quality gate for coding tasks, by Qodo's label on a finding (action_level). The runner decides it from the saved review of a pull request's head, and the agent's instructions are written from it. An open finding whose label is in neither list blocks.

fix.description: An open finding with one of these labels must be fixed before the task is done, whatever its type.

flag.description: An open finding with one of these labels is left unchanged and reported to the owner.

maxRounds.description: The most review rounds a task gets.

network.description: The agent's network in a CI run: the only hosts it can reach, through the runner's proxy, on port 443. Exact host names, no wildcards and no addresses. Adding one is a reviewed change to this file (#330).

path.description: Local checkout, relative to this repo.

guard.description: lab: may name the lab, but its issues, PRs and commits never link to a reviewed repo. reviewed: Qodo reviews it, so nothing sent to it may name the lab or the bug, force pushes are blocked, and nothing links to it.

check.description: The command that must pass before a commit and in CI.

tests.description: Regular expression for test files and test data (fixtures), matched against repo-relative paths. revert:check keeps these at the PR's version and takes away every other changed file.

checkFiles.description: The files that decide whether the check passes. After every factory run the runner compares them between the commit the run started from and its pull request's head; a change fails the run as check-weakened unless the owner labelled the ticket touches-check (#341). Regular expressions on repo-relative paths, ignoring case.

scripts.description: package.json files, compared by their scripts field only, so a dependency change still passes.

ciJobs.description: The CI jobs that must run and succeed before a commit counts as green, by the names GitHub shows. ci:wait fails a commit when one of them did not run, and refuses a repo that names none.

start.description: How to run the app for a live check, or null if there is nothing to run.

checklist.description: The section that holds the checkable items.

board.description: Tracked on the public project board.
